## A little about me

I'm a project manager who likes getting close to the work: untangling requirements, setting priorities, and keeping the path to release clear. I care about the decisions that give a project its shape—what belongs in scope, what needs another pass, and what is ready to ship.

I also build desktop, mobile, and web tools. My tools include VS Code, Codex, and AGY. My projects range from hardware monitoring and document utilities to local video playback.

## What I'm exploring

- **AI & coding agents** — Task scoping, repository context, and checking generated code against the intended behavior.
- **Reverse engineering** — Tracing application behavior and understanding implementation choices.
- **Systems & performance** — Hardware monitoring, memory use, and hardware-accelerated video playback.
- **Interface design** — Typography, keyboard controls, and layouts for desktop utilities.
